### What’s Good About Guidde?

#### Easy to Use

Guidde requires minimal setup: sign up, install, and start recording.

Once your content is captured, it’s ready for review, saving you hours of time when you compare it to manual documentation.

Sure, you have to wait a minute or two for the AI to do its thing, but when it’s done, you get an attractive video complete with AI voice-over, along with written instructions and screenshots that have already been annotated for you.

That’s Enterprise territory. For smaller teams trying to figure out what’s working, this gets frustrating fast. [...] ### 9. No Mobile Creation Support

Guidde doesn’t have a native mobile app for creating content. There’s a workaround using the desktop app to record a mirrored mobile screen, but you can’t natively record and edit directly on iOS or Android devices. That’s a significant limitation for teams documenting mobile-first applications.
